title: Semantic JSON Diff (Ignore Key and Array Order)

seo.title: Semantic JSON Diff (Ignore Key and Array Order) — Private Browser Tool | AafnaiPatro
seo.meta_description: Compare JSON documents by deep semantics: unordered object keys and optionally unordered arrays with duplicate counts preserved. Runs locally in your browser.
seo.h1: Structure comparison: Semantic JSON Diff (Ignore Key and Array Order)

input.label: Two JSON values separated by a line of ---JSON-DIFF---

limits: Unordered arrays implement multiset semantics (duplicates matter); array sorting may erase meaningful sequence semantics. Large nested values are bounded to prevent resource exhaustion.
